answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 53 identities per epoch. Audits are published in prism, queued in crystal, and terrace publishes the wait time. A farm of 38 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2446 identities would post 2384 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
